definitions.full: H8229. shiphah [ שִׁפְעָה ], שִׁפְעַת noun feminine abundance, quantity ; — apparently absolute שִׁפְעַת 2Kin 9:17 , a multitude (of men), (Bur שִׁפְעָה , or אֲנָשִׁים שִׁפְעַת as Klo Benz and others; > ᵐ5 B Kit עָפָר ); construct יֵהוּא שִׁפְעַת 9:17 Jehu's multitude ; construct, of horses Ezek 26:10 , camels Isa 60:6 ; of waters Job 22:11 ; 38:34 .
